headline: Physician | Point-of-Care Ultrasound | Clinical Product Specialist
summary: MBBS-trained physician who has used ultrasound at the bedside in emergency medicine and critical care: lung ultrasound and bedside echo in a COVID ICU, E-FAST and 2D screening echo in a Level 1 trauma centre, and certificate courses in 2D echocardiography and abdominal and pelvic ultrasound. Four years as the clinical voice for product and design teams on a US EHR, and now reviewing medical images and AI outputs for clinical accuracy.
greenway_bullets: Served as the clinical voice for product and design teams: turned recurring provider pain points into PRDs and feature requests, many of which shipped.
Reviewed designs and prototypes for clinical accuracy, usability and workflow fit.
Clinical lead for the new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: provider personas, end-to-end workflow mapping and React prototypes for engineering handoff.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues from detection to stage-gate release on the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees.
Supported adoption across close to 200 client practices and trained 200+ end users.
skills: point-of-care ultrasound (lung, cardiac, trauma, abdominal), bedside echo, medical image annotation, interpretation of X-ray, CT and MRI
clinical requirements, workflow mapping, prototype and usability review, patient safety triage, clinical content review
clinical training, workflow guides, presentations to clients and clinicians
thesis_html: Ultrasound is something I've done at the bedside, not just supported.
why_fit: E-FAST and 2D screening echo in emergency care; lung ultrasound and bedside echo in a COVID ICU.
Four years turning clinician feedback into requirements, prototype reviews and safety triage.
Annotating medical images and grading AI outputs for clinical accuracy.
